questions.prompt: What was LeBron James's scoring average in the 2016 Finals, when he was named MVP?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after averaging 29.7 points, 11.3 rebounds, 8.9 assists, 2.6 steals, and 2.3 blocks.

funFacts.text: LeBron also averaged 11.3 rebounds and 8.9 assists per game in that series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: averaging 29.7 points, 11.3 rebounds, 8.9 assists, 2.6 steals, and 2.3 blocks

funFacts.text: He became the first player to lead an entire Finals series in points, rebounds, assists, steals and blocks.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: lead all players in a playoff series in points, rebounds, assists, steals, and blocks

funFacts.text: Every Finals MVP voter picked LeBron after Cleveland's comeback title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

funFacts.text: The championship roster had been transformed partly by adding ABA star Maurice Lucas.

questions.prompt: In 2012–13 Miami became the first team to win how many games in a single calendar month?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: becoming the first team in NBA history to win at least 17 games in a calendar month

funFacts.text: During that remarkable stretch, Miami completed a sweep of all opposing NBA franchises by beating Indiana.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Heat beat every single team in the NBA with their victory against the Indiana Pacers

funFacts.text: Miami even won in San Antonio while James, Wade and Chalmers were out of the lineup.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Heat defeated the San Antonio Spurs 88-86 without all-stars LeBron James and Dwyane Wade

funFacts.text: Comebacks became routine: Miami erased a double-digit deficit against Detroit late in the streak.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Heat overcame an 11-point deficit to defeat the Detroit Pistons
